title: Co-op join takes the next character (DPC 0.9.172-dev52)
intro: Playing the Arisen, co-op off, two controllers (player 1's and a friend's). Each step waits for End.

probes.chars: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; if not D then return '' end; local c = D.R.cp; if not (c.on or D.coop.active) then return 'off' end; return 'P1 ' .. tostring(c.char[1]) .. ' / P2 ' .. tostring(c.char[2]) .. ' (' .. tostring(c.mode) .. ')'
probes.errs: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'dev_status/DirectPawnControl.json'); return ok and d and d.errors

steps.text: Get ready (see the intro). Press End.

1. PLAYER 1 ON A PAWN: take control of a pawn (L1 + left stick click / F6). Then the friend holds L3 + R3: they should get the Arisen, player 1 keeps the pawn. End co-op (player 1: Ctrl + F6, or L3 + R3 held 3 s on player 1's controller). End when done.

2. A PICK: back on the Arisen, point the selection arrow at a pawn (F7 / D-pad left or right) so the yellow arrow shows, then within 10 s the friend holds L3 + R3: they get that pawn. End co-op. End when done.

3. A PICK WHILE ON A PAWN: take control of a pawn, point the arrow at another pawn, then the friend holds L3 + R3 within 10 s: they get the pointed pawn, player 1 keeps theirs. End co-op. End when done.
Done. Tell Claude how each felt.
